captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a wall-mounted ductless mini-split air conditioning unit. It features a long, sleek rectangular main body with a curved front face in a uniform light gray finish. Along the bottom edge, there is a horizontal outlet opening fitted with a long flap that pivots to direct airflow vertically, and two smaller vertical direction vanes are positioned inside the outlet to swing left and right.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-mounted mini-split air conditioner. The main body should be a long, horizontally extruded unit with a curved front profile. Model a horizontal outlet flap along the bottom edge that rotates on a revolute joint, and include two internal vertical air-directing vanes that pivot independently on vertical axes.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main body of the air conditioner by extruding a 2D profile with a curved front face. It then creates a long, thin horizontal flap for the bottom outlet and attaches it to the main body via a horizontal revolute joint. Finally, it creates two smaller vertical vanes and attaches them behind the flap using independent vertical revolute joints.
